changes.title: Women Jacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Buttoned once, and the cold goes quiet. This relaxed jacket is comfortable to wear because it is made of warm, textured wool with cozy winter insulation and a sophisticated, effortless drape. It has vertical side welt pockets, a single button front, set-in sleeves with tidy cuffs, and a clean collarless neckline. Wear it over a pullover with dark pants for a sleek style, or layer it over a cream zip-up hoodie with loose brown wide-leg cargo sweatpants, dark brown leather flats, and a dark brown woven shoulder bag for a soft, sophisticated look. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Use gentle steam only; do not iron

A small pattern with a gentle feel. This easygoing jacket has a traditional black-and-off-white houndstooth weave and is made of thick, textured wool with cozy winter insulation and a structured, easy drape. It features two front patch pockets, a hidden front fastening, drop-shoulder sleeves with tidy cuffs, and a clean collarless neckline. Wear it over a black knit top with flowing off-white wide-leg pants, black-and-cream flats, and a sleek black leather bag for a monochromatic look. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Use gentle steam only; do not iron

Easy warmth, like a blanket by the window. Made from warm, structured wool with cozy winter insulation and a refined shape, this tailored jacket has a smooth silhouette. It has a classic pointed collar, a full-zip placket, set-in sleeves with broad, tidy cuffs, and side welt pockets. Layer it over brown wide-leg cargo sweatpants, leather flats, and a structured brown suede handbag for a soft professional appearance. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Use gentle steam only; do not iron

changes.title: Men Jacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Soft as fresh snowfall. Made from plush, dense fur with a rich, velvety texture, this relaxed jacket brings luxurious winter warmth and a comfortable, easy shape. It has a classic spread collar, an exposed full-length metal zip, angled side welt pockets, and long sleeves with ribbed cuffs and hem. Layer it over a cream knit with dark tailored trousers and polished leather boots for a rich, wintry look, or wear it over a plain tee for a casual look. 

Care Instructions:
• Hand-wash at up to 30°C/86°F
• Gentle handling; do not wring or twist
• Line dry or tumble dry low; do not dry in direct sunlight
• Do not bleach
• Do not iron

changes.title: Men Jacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Gentle suede for slow, wintry days. This relaxed jacket is easy to wear and has a simple, structured shape. It is made of soft suede with velvety winter warmth. It features saddle-seam shoulders, angled side welt pockets, a full-length front zip, a stand-up collar with a metal snap collar closure, and sleeves with buttoned cuffs and a fitted waistband. Wear it over a slate-grey waffle-knit sweater with dark brown pants and tan vintage shoes for a warm look. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand wash or spot clean at up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle handling; do not rub
● Air dry away from heat and direct sunlight; do not tumble dry
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron

changes.title: Men Corduroy Jacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Made from soft, vertically ribbed corduroy, this relaxed jacket offers cosy warmth and a comfortable fit for cooler days. It features a stand-up funnel collar, a full-length front zipper, a straight hem, and long sleeves with clean cuffs. Layer over a burgundy collared polo shirt with straight-leg off-white trousers and beige slip-on loafers with white soles for a smart, relaxed everyday look.

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F; inside out
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Iron with medium heat on the reverse side only

changes.title: Men Shacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Sand-toned, soft and still. Crafted from soft knitted twill fabric, this beige shacket combines a neat textured finish with a comfortable feel. It features a spread collar, metallic snap-button closure, two chest pockets with buttoned flaps, long sleeves with structured cuffs, and a straight hem. Wear it over a plain white T-shirt with washed black wide-leg jeans and grey sneakers for a sleek, modern look. 

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Low heat; do not iron directly on prints/embroidery
